pw.privacy.title: Your code stays between you and your servers
pw.privacy.keychain.title: Tokens stay in your Keychain
pw.privacy.keychain.text: Personal access tokens and the GitHub sign-in live in the macOS Keychain. Settings and history are plain files in your Library folder.
pw.privacy.server.title: No server in between
pw.privacy.server.text: Pullwatch talks straight to the servers of your accounts on GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Bitbucket, Codeberg, Forgejo and Gitea. It has no account, no server of its own and no analytics.
pw.privacy.sources.title: Every connection listed
pw.privacy.sources.text: Settings, Sources shows each outside service with the address it calls. Switch off any data source and Pullwatch says what it could not check.
pw.get.title: Get Pullwatch
pw.get.text: Free and open source under the Apache 2.0 license. For macOS 26.6 or later, on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple.
